# A post-and-rail fence round the pitch: posts 0.12 m square, 0.95 m tall about 2.1 m apart, two
# rails (0.14 x 0.06 m) at 0.36 and 0.74 m; taller pennant posts at the corners. Generated by make_env.py.

active P1
join
rename P1 Fence
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export fence.glb
